# Fixtures for `dos_exe` (MS-DOS / NE / LE executables)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The programs print a fictitious harbour's tide table (Saltmere Harbour); keys were made for the run and are not secrets. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/executables.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides-mz.exe` | craft_executables.py: an MS-DOS program that prints the harbour name | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-ne.exe` | craft_executables.py: a Windows 3.1 NE header (module name, description), no segments | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-le.vxd` | craft_executables.py: a Windows 386 LE virtual device header, no pages | CC0-1.0 |
